title: Hatsune Miku — Where Feelings Come Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
M-Miku?!
Wait, you look like... The original?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose you would be surprised since you've all become so used to seeing such different variations of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, what is this place?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see a tree and some grass, but that's it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place came to be because all of your feelings have become intertwined.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may not be quite ready to become its own SEKAI, but it's filled with warmth. A sort of warmth that has someone specific in mind...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you all remember what you were thinking about before you came here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Take a look at that tree over there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hold on, is that sheet music...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I... I wrote these.
Hang on, there's more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, this is the first script I ever wrote for Wonderlands×Showtime!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, for Pegasus Odyssey...?
Mind if I take a... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
This is a flyer for STAY GOLDEN!
And one for RAD WEEKEND?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've only ever seen it before in SEKAI, but does that mean this is another SEKAI...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's that photo you took for us! You know, when my friends and I decided to form MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I still remember how surprised I was when you said your group would be using it as a publicity photo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because it's such a good picture!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is there anything for you, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These are the wish plaques that we wrote for New Year's! Some sheet music from practice and my lyrics notebook too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, Miku...
Why are all these things hanging from this tree?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This must be a “Wishing Tree” that's made up of all of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A Wishing Tree... Not a well, but a tree?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may also have to do with your hopes and dreams.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, hold on. But we were all thinking about you just before we came here. How is that related to this tree...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We also want you and your feelings to keep growing and moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, that includes each “Miku” that you're all individually familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is why this Wishing Tree isn't just your tree...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We also have hope and dreams regarding all of you, which likely helps nurture it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were all able to discover your “true feelings” and had the courage to believe in “me”...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As a result, this tree has been able to flourish and sparkle the way it is now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for discovering your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for placing your trust in “me”. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, we should be the ones thanking you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Without you, Miku, I wouldn't have been able to put on that show for Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree! Miku, you're the reason I was able to find the courage to stop running away from everything!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too...
I wouldn't have been able to find what I did without you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because you were there for me, Miku, I was able to compose a song that could actually reach into someone's heart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm of the same mind.
I used to be someone who used to yammer on without listening to what others had to say...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But thanks to you, Miku, I was able to remember what truly means most to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I was able to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No!
There's so much I still need to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Will we ever be able to come back?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place isn't quite ready to become its own SEKAI yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for now, this is goodbye...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This place won't be gone forever.
It's just going back to being a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the very least, it'll remain in your hearts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When this sapling becomes a fully-grown tree, we might just be able to...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Please, give my other selves my regards.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... Where were we just now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait... I went somewhere just now...
I even talked to someone and really wanted to keep talking to them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I felt happy... But sad too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For some reason, I really want to see Miku now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I never thought I'd ever get to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's okay, everyone, we'll see other again soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our feelings will always be connected.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So when we do meet next time, let's all sing together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'll be looking forward to singing something new.
